paras: Enhance the stance and handling of your BMW Z4 (G29) or Toyota Supra (A90) with AST Adjustable Lowering Springs. This system is designed specifically for models equipped with Electronic Damping Control (EDC) , allowing you to customise your ride height while retaining full functionality of your factory adaptive suspension modes.

By using the adjusters on the original EDC dampers, you can achieve a more aggressive look and a lower centre of gravity, which reduces body roll and sharpens steering response. These springs are engineered to provide a significant visual upgrade without sacrificing the premium ride quality or the versatility of your electronic suspension. Every kit is 100% made in the Netherlands to ensure premium quality and long-term durability.
